status_summary: On 2025-01-20 Executive Order 14151 directed agencies to terminate diversity, equity and inclusion offices and positions to the maximum extent allowed by law. On 2025-03-10 NIH rescinded the 2021 notices that required conference grant applicants to include a plan to enhance diversity in selecting speakers and participants. A December 2025 opinion article by NIH leadership says NIH dismantled its DEI apparatus but does not name the Office of Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion, and the office's web site still presented the office's services when fetched in October 2026, so its abolition is not confirmed.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14151 (published 2025-01-29) directed each agency to terminate DEI offices and positions to the maximum extent allowed by law within sixty days.
NIH rescinded notices NOT-OD-21-053 and NOT-OD-21-055, ending the requirement for a Plan to Enhance Diversity in R13 and U13 conference grant applications.
timeline.source: NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts

title: Abolish NIH Office of Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion; end set women-panelist counts
uncertainties: The two rescinded NIH Guide notices (rescission 2025-03-10) and the edi.nih.gov site were read by the researcher, and NOT-OD-21-053 was re-read in review on 2026-10-18 on grants.nih.gov; the site may be served from a cache and shows no closure notice. A Federal Register API search for NIH documents naming the Office of Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion since 2025-01-20 returned 0 documents, and a review variant (Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion with NIH) returned one unrelated OPM notice. One further web search on the office's closure returned only university and grant-termination items, none about this office. An NIH almanac page for the Office of the Director could not be fetched. The NIH leadership opinion article of 2025-12-11 names no office. Whether the 2021 notices amounted to a numerical quota of women panelists is the Mandate's characterization, not the notices' text.
